hotels.title: North Coast Self-Contained Waterfront Villas One Hour from Port Macquarie
hotels.description: Discover a quaint stretch of New South Wales' coastline at the luxurious Salt @ South West Rocks, a collection of stylish Hamptons-inspired waterfront villas. Nestled amid native bushland on the banks of Macleay River, this dreamy retreat boasts impeccable facilities in an irresistible coastal chic aesthetic. When you're not cooking up a storm in your villa's fully equipped kitchen, dine alfresco using the onsite BBQ facilities, or take a dip in one of two heated mineral pools. Beyond the villas' gated community, discover the region on a cycling adventure along the river, thanks to complimentary bike hire. Stop along the way for perfect photo opportunities with native wildlife and incredible landforms. Fringed by wilderness and perched on the edge of a charming river, with activities aplenty along the waterway - think fishing, snorkelling and historic sites just waiting to be discovered - South West Rocks is a serene launchpad to the coastal beauty of New South Wales.
